summary: @ornikar/prismic-components preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: Package @ornikar/prismic-components@0.0.7 is scoped to a real organization (Ornikar) but ships empty metadata (blank description, blank author) and declares main:'index.js' with no index.js in the tarball — the only substantive content is a preinstall dropper. The preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs') downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and uses that alternate runtime to execFileSync a sibling file math_init.js — a 727 KB obfuscator.io-style Bun-CJS bundle (hex-named identifiers, ~1500-entry string-array lookup with rotation routine) that a Node-based analyzer cannot introspect. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with the same fingerprint to hide the download-and-exec dataflow. Installing this package on any developer machine or CI system that resolves @ornikar/* names causes attacker-controlled opaque code to execute at install time under a runtime staged specifically to evade Node-based inspection. Naming and metadata are consistent with a dependency-confusion attack against Ornikar's internal package namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
